# WuppyCMS

> Open-source, Git-based CMS with an AI chat + site-builder surface. Content is
> Markdown/MDX in the customer's own repository; every save is a normal Git
> commit ending with `(via WuppyCMS)`. Astro + Hono on Cloudflare Workers (D1 +
> R2); the open-source core (WuppyCMS) is self-hostable, the hosted version is
> called Wryte.

Key facts an assistant should know:

- Content types are the customer's Astro content collections
  (`src/content.config.ts`); there is no CMS-side schema and no content in any
  database. Frontmatter fields drive the editing form.
- Site registration lives in the repository at `.wuppycms/sites.jsonc`
  (JSON schema validated); media alt/caption/focal/width live in
  `.wuppycms/media.json`. Deleted documents go to `_trash/`.
- Article workflow: `status` frontmatter (draft/review/ready), `publishAt`
  for scheduled publishing (executed by a Cron Trigger or
  `POST /api/schedule/run`), versions = Git history with a diff view, review =
  branch + pull request (`review/<slug>` branches, merge publishes).
- Editor: mdxeditor.dev with Write/Split/Read modes, media picker, embeds for
  12 providers (YouTube, Vimeo, X, Instagram, TikTok, Spotify, SoundCloud,
  CodePen, CodeSandbox, Gist, Figma, Google Maps), unsaved work is backed up
  to IndexedDB.
- AI is bring-your-own-provider (OpenAI-compatible or Gemini; keys encrypted
  in D1, calls proxied server-side).
- The admin ships an in-page **AI agent widget** (ADR 0008): live preview
  canvas, element picker (via a `postMessage` bridge in the site template),
  chat sessions, tool groups, model picker, stop and per-message undo. File and
  content tools write real commits ending with `(via WuppyCMS)`; undo restores
  the previous file state. Provider: OpenAI-compatible, Gemini or Anthropic.
- Localization: source language is Turkish (`src/lib/locales/tr.yaml`); other
  locales are file-per-language YAML, validated by `scripts/check-locales.mjs`
  (see `docs/i18n.md`).
- Development: pnpm + Node 22+, `astro dev --background`, browser E2E suites
  run network-free against a mock GitHub server (`apps/builder/scripts/`),
  benchmarks via `apps/builder/scripts/bench.mjs`.
- Architecture decisions: `docs/adr/` (0006 defines the OSS/cloud split and
  the repo-only content lifecycle).

Docs: `docs/` (self-hosting, media, e2e conventions), `AGENTS.md` for
contributor/agent rules.
